package.description: A controller for usb driven LED backlights (an unofficial fork)

en-US.description: A controller for usb driven LED backlights (an unofficial fork)
en-US.longDescription: Prismatik is an open-source software to control Lightpack devices. It grabs the screen, analyzes the picture, calculates resulting colors, and provides soft and gentle lighting with a Lightpack device. Moreover, you can handle other devices with Prismatik such as Adalight, Ardulight, or even Alienware LightFX system.
en-US.name: Prismatik (unofficial)
